title: Framing Threats and Justifying Actions: A Multitheoretical Analysis of Avichai Adraee’s Facebook Discourse
core_idea: Use multiple theoretical lenses to examine how Avichai Adraee's Facebook posts frame threats and construct justifications for actions, focusing on the discursive strategies and rhetorical mechanisms that shape perceptions and legitimize responses.
tldr: A multitheoretical discourse analysis of Avichai Adraee's Facebook content aimed at uncovering how threats are framed and actions are justified through specific rhetorical and discursive strategies.
